title: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.34864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. Several offline speedup methods have focused on identifying segments that require less precision and assigning predefined speedup factors to the segments. However, even within a single segment, a speedup factor suitable for steady motion may be too high when precise alignment is required. To this end, this paper presents RePace, an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration. For the same recorded movement, RePace measures how much each candidate speedup factor shortens the sequence and compares the resulting observation-action pairs used for training. translated_title: RePace：通过推理演示加速实现更快的视觉-语言-动作策略
translated_abstract: 由于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可能会继承人类演示的缓慢节奏，在微调之前对这些演示进行加速可以产生更快的VLA策略，而无需在部署时附加额外的速度选择模块。现有的几种离线加速方法侧重于识别需要较低精度的片段，并为这些片段分配预定义的加速因子。然而，即使在单个片段内部，适合稳定运动的加速因子在需要精确对齐时可能过高。为此，本文提出了RePace，一个离线推理框架，用于确定演示的每个部分应加速多少。对于同一段录制的运动，RePace测量每个候选加速因子能在多大程度上缩短序列，并比较由此产生的用于训练的观测-动作对。给定任务指令，预训练的语言模型利用视觉上下文和原始运动信息（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: RePace是一个离线推理框架，利用预训练语言模型结合视觉上下文和任务指令，为演示的每个部分自适应地推理出合适的加速因子，从而在微调前加速人类演示数据，训练出更快的视觉-语言-动作策略。
en_tdlr: RePace is an offline reasoning framework that leverages a pretrained language model with visual context and task instructions to adaptively determine appropriate speedup factors for each part of a demonstration, enabling faster vision-language-action policies through acceleration of demonstrations before fine-tuning.
